violation_type.title: Requirements for Tire - Minimum Clearance (26 TAC §746.4705(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: During the inspection I observed 3 tire swings, none of the tire swings met the 30 inch clearance requirements when held up at the highest peak.

finding_variants.text: During the inspection I observed 3 tire swings, none of the tire swings met the 30 inch clearance requirements when held up at the highest peak.

There was a tire swing at the operation that was hanging from a tree. The swing did not have the required 30 inch clearance between the seat of the swing and the support structure. The tire was able to run into the tree trunk when swinging. The director removed the tire swing during the inspection.
